Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Blood Wave is the only Necromancer build ranked B or better on all three owner references and guided on all three: d4builds B [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16], InfinityBuilds A (Akiha, '【Qiuye】S15 Core Blood Wave', page updated 2026-09-14) [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16], Maxroll S on the overall endgame list (2nd of 7) and A on push [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]. Disagreement kept visible: the highest-weighted site rates it lowest (B); d4builds' only higher Necromancer entry, 'Shadow Dot' A, has no guide. Construction: late endgame follows the d4builds build 'Blood Wave - Necromancer (S15)', variant 'Standard Build', last updated 2026-09-15 (weighted first); leveling, early endgame and pushing follow Maxroll planner de23ph0q 'Blood Wave s15' (guide by LordxSaura, updated 2026-09-15; planner saved 2026-09-15), because d4builds publishes one endgame variant only and no InfinityBuilds variant covers those stages [https://d4builds.gg/builds/blood-wave-necromancer-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/de23ph0q - 2026-09-16]. Three-way Overpower-unique disagreement: Maxroll wears Banished Lord's Talisman (amulet, with Tidal Aspect) and Red Blessing (charm); InfinityBuilds the reverse (Red Blessing amulet, Banished Lord's Talisman charm); d4builds neither - an Aspect of Redirected Force amulet transfigured with Aspect of Interdiction and Blood-Mad Idol as the unique charm. Skill-bar disagreement: Maxroll Reap/Blood Wave/Blood Lance/Sever/Bone Prison/Blood Mist; d4builds Sever/Blood Lance/Bone Prison/Corpse Tendrils/Decrepify/Blood Wave; InfinityBuilds Decrepify/Sever/Corpse Tendrils/Blood Wave/Skeleton Mage/Bone Prison - two of three, d4builds included, bar Decrepify and Corpse Tendrils and drop Reap and Blood Mist, so late endgame follows d4builds [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/builds/12775-necromancer-iZrCF7v-ut - 2026-09-16]. 3.2.1 facts that touch it: Hematolagnia 50 to 70 Essence, its Overpower upgrade now 'grants 1 stack of Overpower and increases your Maximum Overpower by 2'; Word of the Blood Binder 5-piece 75%[x] to 100%[x]; Red Blessing and Banished Lord's Talisman reworked into Overpower spenders; Embattled Aspect fixed to 150-200% - whether Maxroll's 'instant fortify healing (it is a bug)' survives is unverified [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394 - 2026-09-16]. Maxroll's guide is internally inconsistent: its Endgame prose says 'Aspect of Hardened Bones on helmet' while its Season 15 planner and mythic list put Leoric's Crown in the helm; the planner is treated as current. Leoric's Crown gem-effect value: data-mined 35-50%[x] vs PTR-era 75-100% - unverified, re-verify. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game.

Rotation
  1. Keep Decrepify up and Blood Wave held down; Blood Lance every 5 seconds to re-trigger Bloodbath by spending and regaining Overpower; Corpse Tendrils and Bone Prison on cooldown; Sever to move.
  2. The Tam/Teb runes on Kessime's Legacy cast Iron Maiden for you.
Variants

Leveling — Spam Blood Wave; Sever and Blood Mist to teleport (Blood Mist consumes Sever's corpse for Flesh-eater); Blood Lance from range to spend Overpower; Bone Prison for attack speed on tanky packs; Reap when Essence runs dry. Teb casts Iron Maiden automatically. [Maxroll planner de23ph0q notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Swap to the early-endgame kit when you have Leoric's Crown and a Greater Splinter of Anguish and Hellfire to socket in it, and Kessime's Legacy is already on.

Early Endgame — Spam Blood Wave; Sever and Blood Mist to teleport; Blood Lance from range to spend Overpower; Bone Prison for attack speed; Reap when Essence runs dry. Decrepify is auto-applied by Wat; Life Tap generates Blood Orbs; Iron Maiden auto-cast by Teb picks them up. [Maxroll planner de23ph0q notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Move to late endgame when you own Ring of Starless Skies and Squirt's Blouse and have Fists of Fate as a Mythic - then respec to the d4builds bar (Decrepify and Corpse Tendrils in, Reap and Blood Mist out).

Late Endgame — Maintain Decrepify; cast Blood Wave to fill Overpower stacks; cast Blood Lance every 5 seconds to maintain Bloodbath; Corpse Tendrils and Bone Prison on cooldown; spam Blood Wave; Sever for mobility. [d4builds S15 notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Go to the push kit when Blood-Mad Idol drops as a Mythic amulet and you can hold 100% Block Chance with Aspect of Interdiction on the amulet (Maxroll push requirement).

Pushing — Blood Lance from range before engaging; Bone Prison before packs reach you; pull a small pack first and cast Blood Wave until Decrepify has built your Resolve stacks - engaging a big pack at zero stacks kills you; Blood Wave keeps Overpower at 11 so no orbs are needed; Reap for a corpse, Corpse Tendrils (Jaws of Death) to consume it for Flesh-eater; Blood Mist every ~8 s for Unstoppable and movement. [Maxroll planner de23ph0q push notes, condensed, 2026-09-16; its Aspect of Disobedience line is carried-over Season 14 wording and omitted]
Move on when Final stage - upgrade Soul Splinters to Abyssal and masterwork the Resolve-stack tempers.

Stat requirements
  • Maxroll Endgame: more than 15 Essence Regeneration
  • Maxroll Endgame: more than 15% Resource Cost Reduction
  • Maxroll Endgame: three greater-affix Lucky Hit restore-resource tempers on jewelry
  • Maxroll Endgame: more than 70% Critical Strike Chance
  • Maxroll Endgame: more than 50% Attack Speed with Ferocity stacks
  • Maxroll Push: 100% Block Chance
  • InfinityBuilds (Akiha): Critical Strike Chance budget to 85%
Lootfilter

Blood Wave Necromancer - Maxroll Light / Medium / Strict (Season 15 planner import codes) — View Filter

maxroll.gg

The Season 15 planner de23ph0q (saved 2026-09-15) embeds three filter codes, Maxroll Light, Medium and Strict - exact match for this build; use Strict from late endgame. No Season 15 Necromancer filter exists in the InfinityBuilds directory (read 2026-09-16: its only Season 15 entry is a Sorcerer general filter). Unhide jewelry for Soul Splinters.

  4. Kessime's Legacy: gamble pants or farm Andariel (Maxroll de23ph0q, 2026-09-16).
  5. Soul Splinters: Splinter of Pain (ring 1), Splinter of the Black Soulstone (ring 2), Splinter of Anguish (amulet). Soul Splinters are not gems or runes, so they are recorded here in words rather than in socketing (the schema and the game data have no Soul Splinter kind yet).

Skill point priority

  1. Maxroll Midgame floors: >15 Essence Regeneration, >25% Resource Cost Reduction, 3x greater-affix Lucky Hit restore-resource tempers on jewelry, >60% Critical Strike Chance, >50% Attack Speed with Ferocity (Maxroll de23ph0q, 2026-09-16).
  2. Soul Splinters (Maxroll midgame order): Greater Splinter of the Black Soulstone (amulet), Greater Splinter of Hellfire (in Leoric's Crown), Greater Splinter of Anguish (in Leoric's Crown), Greater Splinter of Pain (ring 2). Soul Splinters are not gems or runes, so they are recorded here in words rather than in socketing (the schema and the game data have no Soul Splinter kind yet). Hellfire caveat (the −100% Critical Strike Chance drawback is first-party since 2026-09-20; how the reference's crit floor survives it is unresolved): Splinter of Hellfire trades its damage for −100% Critical Strike Chance [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24292852/the-3-2-0-ptr-what-you-need-to-know - 2026-09-13]; the live 3.2.1 game data carries the same drawback (knowledge base, Soul Splinters, 2026-09-16) and the shipped game confirms it (attribute description S15_Socketable_NaKrul, the game files SNO 4080, script formula SF_1 = 1 in the game files; local install 3.2.1.73552 - 2026-09-20; the per-tier damage bonus stays a data-mined value, unconfirmed), yet Maxroll's Midgame profile (de23ph0q) pairs it with Splinter of Anguish in Leoric's Crown and a >60% Critical Strike Chance floor as published; this site keeps the gear as the reference publishes it. Follow the reference, then check the character sheet with Hellfire socketed: if Critical Strike Chance reads 0%, treat the Critical Strike Chance floor, every Critical Strike Chance affix and temper and Splinter of Anguish's crit line as dead, and test Splinter of Anguish or Pain in Hellfire's place on a dummy - the reference's crit floor against the drawback is unresolved, re-verify in game.
  3. Aspect of Deluge until Ring of Starless Skies (Maxroll de23ph0q, 2026-09-16).
  4. Tidal Aspect feeds Overpower stacks for Banished Lord's Talisman and Red Blessing (Maxroll de23ph0q, 2026-09-16).
  5. Talisman here (Maxroll Midgame): Legendary Horadric Seal with 5-piece Word of the Blood Binder and Red Blessing as the unique charm.

How to run them

d4builds S15 (2026-09-16) hires Raheir and reinforces with Varyana's Bloodthirst on Blood Wave; its Raheir tree is not decodable, so no hired skills are listed. Maxroll's S15 planner (and InfinityBuilds) instead hire Subo - Opening Fire, Piercing Arrows, Cover Fire, Wire Trap; 'map visibility and 25% extra critical damage multiplier' - with Raheir's Bastion as the reinforcement (Maxroll push: triggered on Blood Wave; InfinityBuilds: 'on Skill Cast'; InfinityBuilds' alternative hire is Aldkin for 15% Critical Strike Chance). Two of three references pick Subo + Raheir; d4builds is weighted first.

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Blood Wave is the only Necromancer build ranked B or better on all three owner references and guided on all three: d4builds B [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16], InfinityBuilds A (Akiha, '【Qiuye】S15 Core Blood Wave', page updated 2026-09-14) [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16], Maxroll S on the overall endgame list (2nd of 7) and A on push [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]. Disagreement kept visible: the highest-weighted site rates it lowest (B); d4builds' only higher Necromancer entry, 'Shadow Dot' A, has no guide. Construction: late endgame follows the d4builds build 'Blood Wave - Necromancer (S15)', variant 'Standard Build', last updated 2026-09-15 (weighted first); leveling, early endgame and pushing follow Maxroll planner de23ph0q 'Blood Wave s15' (guide by LordxSaura, updated 2026-09-15; planner saved 2026-09-15), because d4builds publishes one endgame variant only and no InfinityBuilds variant covers those stages [https://d4builds.gg/builds/blood-wave-necromancer-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/de23ph0q - 2026-09-16]. Three-way Overpower-unique disagreement: Maxroll wears Banished Lord's Talisman (amulet, with Tidal Aspect) and Red Blessing (charm); InfinityBuilds the reverse (Red Blessing amulet, Banished Lord's Talisman charm); d4builds neither - an Aspect of Redirected Force amulet transfigured with Aspect of Interdiction and Blood-Mad Idol as the unique charm. Skill-bar disagreement: Maxroll Reap/Blood Wave/Blood Lance/Sever/Bone Prison/Blood Mist; d4builds Sever/Blood Lance/Bone Prison/Corpse Tendrils/Decrepify/Blood Wave; InfinityBuilds Decrepify/Sever/Corpse Tendrils/Blood Wave/Skeleton Mage/Bone Prison - two of three, d4builds included, bar Decrepify and Corpse Tendrils and drop Reap and Blood Mist, so late endgame follows d4builds [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/builds/12775-necromancer-iZrCF7v-ut - 2026-09-16]. 3.2.1 facts that touch it: Hematolagnia 50 to 70 Essence, its Overpower upgrade now 'grants 1 stack of Overpower and increases your Maximum Overpower by 2'; Word of the Blood Binder 5-piece 75%[x] to 100%[x]; Red Blessing and Banished Lord's Talisman reworked into Overpower spenders; Embattled Aspect fixed to 150-200% - whether Maxroll's 'instant fortify healing (it is a bug)' survives is unverified [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394 - 2026-09-16]. Maxroll's guide is internally inconsistent: its Endgame prose says 'Aspect of Hardened Bones on helmet' while its Season 15 planner and mythic list put Leoric's Crown in the helm; the planner is treated as current. Leoric's Crown gem-effect value: data-mined 35-50%[x] vs PTR-era 75-100% - unverified, re-verify. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game.

Rotation
  1. Keep Decrepify up and Blood Wave held down; Blood Lance every 5 seconds to re-trigger Bloodbath by spending and regaining Overpower; Corpse Tendrils and Bone Prison on cooldown; Sever to move.
  2. The Tam/Teb runes on Kessime's Legacy cast Iron Maiden for you.
Variants

Leveling — Spam Blood Wave; Sever and Blood Mist to teleport (Blood Mist consumes Sever's corpse for Flesh-eater); Blood Lance from range to spend Overpower; Bone Prison for attack speed on tanky packs; Reap when Essence runs dry. Teb casts Iron Maiden automatically. [Maxroll planner de23ph0q notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Swap to the early-endgame kit when you have Leoric's Crown and a Greater Splinter of Anguish and Hellfire to socket in it, and Kessime's Legacy is already on.

Early Endgame — Spam Blood Wave; Sever and Blood Mist to teleport; Blood Lance from range to spend Overpower; Bone Prison for attack speed; Reap when Essence runs dry. Decrepify is auto-applied by Wat; Life Tap generates Blood Orbs; Iron Maiden auto-cast by Teb picks them up. [Maxroll planner de23ph0q notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Move to late endgame when you own Ring of Starless Skies and Squirt's Blouse and have Fists of Fate as a Mythic - then respec to the d4builds bar (Decrepify and Corpse Tendrils in, Reap and Blood Mist out).

Late Endgame — Maintain Decrepify; cast Blood Wave to fill Overpower stacks; cast Blood Lance every 5 seconds to maintain Bloodbath; Corpse Tendrils and Bone Prison on cooldown; spam Blood Wave; Sever for mobility. [d4builds S15 notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Go to the push kit when Blood-Mad Idol drops as a Mythic amulet and you can hold 100% Block Chance with Aspect of Interdiction on the amulet (Maxroll push requirement).

Pushing — Blood Lance from range before engaging; Bone Prison before packs reach you; pull a small pack first and cast Blood Wave until Decrepify has built your Resolve stacks - engaging a big pack at zero stacks kills you; Blood Wave keeps Overpower at 11 so no orbs are needed; Reap for a corpse, Corpse Tendrils (Jaws of Death) to consume it for Flesh-eater; Blood Mist every ~8 s for Unstoppable and movement. [Maxroll planner de23ph0q push notes, condensed, 2026-09-16; its Aspect of Disobedience line is carried-over Season 14 wording and omitted]
Move on when Final stage - upgrade Soul Splinters to Abyssal and masterwork the Resolve-stack tempers.

Stat requirements
  • Maxroll Endgame: more than 15 Essence Regeneration
  • Maxroll Endgame: more than 15% Resource Cost Reduction
  • Maxroll Endgame: three greater-affix Lucky Hit restore-resource tempers on jewelry
  • Maxroll Endgame: more than 70% Critical Strike Chance
  • Maxroll Endgame: more than 50% Attack Speed with Ferocity stacks
  • Maxroll Push: 100% Block Chance
  • InfinityBuilds (Akiha): Critical Strike Chance budget to 85%

Blood Lance

CoreBlood

Rank 1/15

Essence Cost: 15

Lucky Hit Chance: 50%

Throw a blood lance, dealing 160% to an enemy that ricochets to another enemy. Enemies hit are lanced for 3 seconds.

When Blood Lance hits an enemy, it deals damage to all other lanced enemies.

Modifiers

  • OverpowerBlood Lance consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to throw an additional lance, dealing 50% of normal damage.
  • FortifyBlood Lance Fortifies you for 4% of your Maximum Life ({x}) if it hits an enemy already lanced.
  • Festering WoundBlood Lance becomes a Darkness Skill and deals Shadow damage. Enemies hit are permanently lanced and the lance deals 100% Corrupting damage per second to them.

MacabreBone

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 15 seconds

Skeleton Warriors heal you for 2% of your Maximum Life ({x}) whenever they attack.

Master of Puppets

UpgradeSkeleton Warrior

Skeleton Warrior's maximum number of warriors is increased by 3.

Service and Sacrifice

UpgradeSkeleton Warrior

Skeleton Warriors lose 25% of their Maximum Life per second while in combat and explode on death, dealing 150% damage.

Skeleton Warriors are now raised from a nearby Corpse every 0.5 seconds.

Litany of Death

UpgradeSkeleton Warrior

If all of your skeletal warriors have been Summoned, Skeleton Warrior briefly Summons a Skeleton Priest instead.

Skeleton Priest empowers your Minions for 8 seconds, increasing their Critical Strike Chance by +15% and healing them for 100% of their Maximum Life over the duration.

Vulnerable

UpgradeSkeleton Warrior

Skeleton Warriors have a 30% chance to make enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

Resolve

UpgradeSkeleton Warrior

Commanding your Skeleton Warriors grants 3 stacks of Resolve.

Golem

Minion

Cooldown: {x} seconds

Cooldown: {x} seconds

Cooldown: {x} seconds

Lucky Hit Chance: 20%

Passive: Raise a Golem that attacks for 137.5% damage. When your Golem dies, it respawns after 10 seconds.

Active: Command your Golem to leap to the target area. It becomes Unstoppable, Taunts Nearby enemies, and takes 30% reduced damage for the next 6 seconds. It gains 50% of its Armor as Thorns for the duration.Active: Command your Golem to leap to the target area. It becomes Unstoppable and drains the blood of enemies, dealing 154% damage and healing 5% of its Life for each enemy drained. Healing received is tripled and damage is increased by 300%[x] if only one enemy is drained.Active: Command your Golem to leap to the target area. It becomes Unstoppable and slams its fists into the ground, dealing 220% damage and Stunning surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.

Physical Damage

Damage Bonus

UpgradeGolem

Golem deals 30%[x] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

Unstoppable

UpgradeGolem

Commanding your Golem also grants you Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

Gargantua

UpgradeGolem

Golem now raises a larger Golem that gains an aura of command, increasing the Cast Speed and Movement Speed of your other Minions by 20%.

Fel Gluttony

UpgradeGolem

Commanding your Golem causes it to erupt, dealing 300% damage to surrounding enemies.

Your Golem passively consumes nearby Corpses every second to reduce its Cooldown by 2 seconds per Corpse consumed.

Gravebloom

UpgradeGolem

Golem now raises 3 smaller Golems that deal 60% of normal damage and gain 30%[+] Attack Speed.

Weaken

UpgradeGolem

Golem Weakens enemies for 4 seconds whenever it attacks.

Resolve, Overpower, or Ferocity

UpgradeGolem

Commanding your Golem grants 3 stacks of Resolve, Overpower, or Ferocity based on whether your Golem type is Bone, Blood, or Iron respectively.

Provoke

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 25 seconds

Raheir Taunts enemies around you for 5 seconds. You gain 5% Damage Reduction for each target, up to 20%.

Ground Slam

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Round Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Strike

Raheir brutalizes the ground, dealing 160% Physical damage and Slowing enemies by 30% for 6 seconds. Targets in the center of the slam are Slowed by 60% instead.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir swings a round shield at enemies, dealing 85% Physical damage. Every 20 swings, Raheir Heals you for 8% of your Maximum Life.

Shield Charge

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Tower Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Bash

Raheir rushes forward aggressively, dealing 110% Physical damage and Taunting nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir bashes enemies with a tower shield, dealing 80% Physical damage and Fortifying you for 0.2% of your Maximum Life.

Crater

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Raheir strikes the ground 3 times, each burst dealing 30% Physical damage and Pulling In enemies. The final burst deals 40% more Physical damage and additionally Stuns enemies for 2 secondseconds.

Raheir's Guard

PassiveRaheir

Raheir grants you 15%[+] Armor.

Vanguard

PassiveRaheir

Raheir Slows surrounding enemies by 40%.

Mocking Lure

PassiveRaheir

You deal 15%[x] increased damage to enemies Taunted by Raheir.

Iron Wolf's Ward

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he Knocks Back Close enemies and Taunts Distant enemies for 4 seconds.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Iron Wolf's Call

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, your next 4 Core Skills within 10 seconds deal 25%[x] increased damage and cost no Resource.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 25%.

Sundering Shield

PassiveRaheir

Raheir's final Crater burst deals 200%[x] increased damage and inflicts Vulnerable on enemies for 4 seconds.

Shield Throw

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Raheir throws his shield, dealing 450% Physical damage and Taunting enemies for 5 seconds. The shield bounces up to 9 times and cannot bounce to the same target twice.

Iron Wolf's Arrival

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he also casts Ground Slam and Shield Throw.

Raheir's Valiance's Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Consecrated Shield

PassiveRaheir

Raheir's Shield Throw Consecrates enemies for 6 seconds. Directly damaging a Consecrated enemy Heals you for 6% of your Maximum Life, once per target.

Bastion

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 30 seconds

Raheir takes a protective position for 5 seconds, redirecting 90% of the damage that would be dealt to surrounding allies to himself for 5 seconds.

Bastion's initial cast also grants surrounding allies Unstoppable for 1.0 secondseconds.

Iron Wolf's Virtue

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he Heals you for 25% of your Maximum Life.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Allies affected by Raheir's Bastion deal 25%[x] increased damage.
